summary: Two strong newly opened, officially live roles now lead the unapplied shortlist: Applied Intuition Research Engineer - New Grad (2027) and Micron New College Grad - AI Innovation Research Engineer. Sentry is removed because Gmail confirms an August 14 application; Marshall Wace is removed because Gmail confirms a company-level application. Mercor's AI interview was completed and Weekday was notified on August 14. Existing Apple, Genmo, Twitch, Crusoe and Cerebras openings remain live or accepting applications, with caveats below.

changes_today.reason: Official Applied Intuition careers page and exact Ashby requisition are live on August 15. Python, PyTorch and distributed machine learning are unusually close to Yuhan's training/inference systems background; official base range is $140k-$200k plus equity.

changes_today.role: New College Grad - AI Innovation Research Engineer
changes_today.reason: Official Micron requisition JR108594 was posted August 15 and its application flow is live. The work covers GenAI/agentic AI research, evaluation and proof-of-concept development; employer-posted range is $113k-$242k.
Gmail exact-role confirmation shows an August 14 application; removed from Apply Now.
Gmail company-level Greenhouse confirmation dated August 14; removed from Apply Now without guessing the requisition.
Gmail Sent confirms Yuhan completed the Mercor AI interview and notified Amit on August 14. This remains a short-term W-2 project, not a 2027 full-time recommendation.

Today's new entries came through already integrated speedyapply 2027 AI/SWE sources and were promoted only after exact official-link verification. No additional public repository added enough distinct signal to justify a new adapter.

recommendations.fit: Excellent Python/PyTorch/distributed-ML fit; physical-AI domain is adjacent rather than identical
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The exact new-grad role values Python, PyTorch, computer vision/robotics systems and distributed machine-learning models. Her MS research, distributed training/inference and production AI work cover the systems half strongly.
recommendations.team_value: Multi-GPU, NCCL, model-loading and runtime optimization evidence can translate directly to scaling physical-AI training and evaluation workloads.
recommendations.why_attractive: High-pay 2027 new-grad research engineering at the infrastructure layer of a leading physical-AI company.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says New Grad (2027); company careers listing and Ashby application are live on August 15, 2026.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated on the exact posting; no explicit no-sponsorship or citizenship veto found in the accessible official listing.
recommendations.urgency: Top application after the move; newly posted and likely to attract heavy volume.
recommendations.caveat: Computer vision/robotics evidence is weaker than MLSys evidence. Lead with distributed model systems, not old C++ contest work.

recommendations.role: New College Grad - AI Innovation Research Engineer
recommendations.fit: Strong GenAI/agentic-AI research and applied prototyping; less directly inference/runtime
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Official new-college-grad scope plus preferred GenAI, ML, agentic AI and intelligent-systems research aligns with her MS research and production AI-agent engineering.
recommendations.team_value: She can bring rigorous systems experimentation and model-serving awareness to evaluating emerging AI technologies and building proof-of-concepts.
recommendations.why_attractive: Fresh NCG opening with a high salary ceiling and research-to-production scope rather than hardware design.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says New College Grad; requisition JR108594 and its apply flow are live on August 15, 2026.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated on the exact posting; Micron sponsorship history is not proof for this requisition, so answer OPT/future sponsorship truthfully.
recommendations.caveat: The role is broader AI innovation/PoC work, not a dedicated distributed-inference team. Confirm May 2027 start timing if contacted.

recommendations.role: Software Engineer - AiDP Reliability Engineering, IS&T, Early Career Opportunities
recommendations.salary: Not listed on the accessible official posting
recommendations.fit: Exceptional ML platform / inference / reliability overlap
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Python plus systems, OS/networking and open-source platform experience fit the early-career qualifications; Spark/Flink/Trino/Iceberg and Kubernetes exposure are preferred rather than deep modern C++.
recommendations.team_value: Apple's Applied ML team builds ML, GenAI, inference and data platforms, making vLLM/model-loading, NCCL/multi-GPU and systems-optimization evidence directly relevant.
recommendations.why_attractive: One of the rare elite-company early-career roles explicitly centered on production ML and inference platforms.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact title says Early Career; role 200677645-0157 was posted August 12, 2026 and shows Submit Resume.
recommendations.sponsorship: Not stated; no explicit no-sponsorship language found.
recommendations.urgency: Apply promptly with ML-platform/reliability bullets prioritized.
recommendations.caveat: A different Apple Siri requisition is already active; submit only this highly differentiated role and avoid broad Apple spraying.
recommendations.application_limit: No published cap found; keep this as the single additional targeted Apple application.

recommendations.fit: Strong Python/PyTorch and distributed model-training overlap; weaker visual-generation evidence
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Recent BS/MS graduates qualify, and the official role values Python, PyTorch, distributed compute, GPU optimization and ML infrastructure.
recommendations.team_value: Her training/inference systems and multi-GPU optimization work could contribute to scaling and deployment.
recommendations.why_attractive: Frontier generative-video work with hands-on model performance and infrastructure.
recommendations.new_grad: Official exact New Grad requisition is live and accepting applications.
recommendations.sponsorship: E-Verify is stated; visa sponsorship is not stated.
recommendations.urgency: Apply after the top three if she can show a credible generative-model project.
recommendations.caveat: Two years of ML and meaningful generative-model/CV work are expected; do not overstate diffusion experience. Four to five days onsite.

recommendations.fit: Strong scalable backend/services; weaker direct ML-systems overlap
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: The official role asks for a CS degree, algorithms/data modeling, AWS and 1+ year as a software engineer. Her TikTok internship and substantial systems work make this plausible, though the experience wording is a caveat.
recommendations.team_value: Production ownership, distributed backend experience and algorithms are relevant to high-scale creator payments services.
recommendations.why_attractive: Elite consumer-scale backend work with clear compensation and a live application.
recommendations.new_grad: Official title is Engineer I, not explicitly new grad; retained as early-career because requirements are entry-level in substance.
recommendations.sponsorship: The application explicitly asks about current/future immigration support but does not state a no-sponsorship veto.
recommendations.urgency: Apply after the two exact 2027 NCG roles and Apple.
recommendations.caveat: Payments is not ML infrastructure, and '1+ years as a software engineer' may be interpreted more strictly than internship/research experience.
recommendations.application_limit: Twitch is an Amazon subsidiary; avoid duplicate near-identical Twitch applications.

recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: Engineer I accepts internships, school projects or roughly one year of experience; Linux, reliability and distributed systems align.
recommendations.team_value: Her performance and distributed-systems work maps to storage reliability and AI-cloud infrastructure.
recommendations.why_attractive: Core systems work at an AI-compute company rather than product frontend.
recommendations.new_grad: Official full-time Engineer I role is live, but is not explicitly labeled 2027/new grad.
recommendations.urgency: Secondary; verify Crusoe allows multiple active applications first.
recommendations.caveat: A different Crusoe Engineer I/DCIE requisition is already active, creating duplicate-company risk.
recommendations.application_limit: Apply only if multiple active Crusoe requisitions are permitted.

recommendations.fit: Relevant ML runtime/performance work but heavily modern-C++/CUDA-oriented
recommendations.plausible_for_yuhan: NCCL, parallel systems and performance work are relevant, but deep recent modern-C++ and kernel expertise are not her leading strengths.
recommendations.team_value: Multi-GPU communication and inference/training systems evidence may still transfer at the software/hardware boundary.
recommendations.why_attractive: High-impact AI systems performance work that is software, not pure hardware.
recommendations.new_grad: Official University requisition explicitly says New Grad and remains live.
recommendations.urgency: Low-priority stretch after better mutual-fit roles.
recommendations.caveat: Do not lead with old contest C++; choose a US placement because OPT does not authorize Canadian employment.
